statement.p: What number could you multiply by each term in the second equation that would be helpful?

solution.p: If we multiply the second equation through by -3 then the y-terms will be 6y and -6y\text{,} and adding will eliminate y\text{.}

statement.p: After multiplying the terms in the second equation by -3 and adding the two equations together, solve for x\text{.}
Now solve for y as well, by substituting \frac{4}{7} in for x in one of the original equations.
